name: Office files
description: Makes Word, Excel and PowerPoint files from chat. The files are yours, in My files in your data folder, and open in Office. It can also change them, once you turn that on in Settings.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.make_document: Make a Word, Excel or PowerPoint file on this computer, in the owner's files.
tools.edit_document: Change a Word, Excel or PowerPoint file in the owner's files or a folder she linked: add paragraphs, rows or slides, or replace text.

make_document: write my letter to the school as a Word document
make slides for my talk on gardening
edit_document: add a row for sunscreen to my packing list
replace Bob with Ann in my letter

consent: Office files makes Word, Excel and PowerPoint files in My files in your data folder. It doesn't use the internet once it is installed, and removing it never removes your files.
